title: Woman with Orange Hair
description: A woman with long flowing orange hair looks down and to the side with a neutral expression. Her right hand rests on her upper chest near her shoulder while a small dark silhouette of a figure stands on a wooden boat-like shape across her chest and shoulder area against a light background with orange paint marks.
prompt: A close-up portrait of a beautiful woman with very long flowing bright orange hair that blows dramatically to the left. She has fair skin, red lips, and looks down and to the right with a neutral expression. Her right hand rests on her upper chest near her bare shoulder. A small dark silhouette of a figure holding a spear stands on a wooden boat shape painted across her chest. The background is light beige with orange paint splatters and marks. The entire image has a painterly style with visible brush strokes and texture.
